# AgentScout

> AgentScout is a curated directory of 808 AI agent tools for builders and ready-to-use products. Facts are verified; pricing is as makers state it.

Site: https://agentscouthq.com/
X: https://x.com/AgentScoutHQ
Contact: support@agentscouthq.com

## Machine-readable catalog

- [tools.json](https://agentscouthq.com/tools.json): full catalog
- [sitemap.xml](https://agentscouthq.com/sitemap.xml): all public pages

## Recently added
- [All new tools, last 30 days](https://agentscouthq.com/new.html)

- [Langchain.rb](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/langchain-rb.html) (added 2026-10-18): Ruby library for building LLM-powered applications, RAG and assistants.
- [Ante](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/ante.html) (added 2026-10-18): Self-contained Rust terminal coding agent from Antigma Labs that works with any model and has no runtime dependencies.
- [LangGraph4j](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/langgraph4j.html) (added 2026-10-18): Java library for building stateful multi-agent applications as graphs, working with LangChain4j and Spring AI.
- [Intelligent Terminal](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/intelligent-terminal.html) (added 2026-10-18): Experimental fork of Windows Terminal with native integration for ACP-compatible agent CLIs.
- [ElatoAI](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/elatoai.html) (added 2026-10-18): Realtime voice AI for ESP32 devices and toys with 100+ speech and LLM model options.
- [ADR](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/adr.html) (added 2026-10-18): Uber's Agentic AI Detection and Response system that secures employee and customer-facing AI agents with observability and threat detection.
- [superglue](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/superglue.html) (added 2026-10-18): AI agents that connect, migrate and implement enterprise systems like NetSuite and SAP, cloud-hosted or self-hosted.
- [Ui.Vision RPA](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/ui-vision-rpa.html) (added 2026-10-18): Browser and desktop automation extension with OCR and image recognition, plus an MCP server so AI agents can create and run macros.
- [Jarvis](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/jarvis.html) (added 2026-10-18): Private, local-first desktop AI assistant with voice and text chat, personal memory, dictation and MCP tools.
- [Agent Safehouse](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/agent-safehouse.html) (added 2026-10-18): macOS sandbox for local coding agents that limits file and integration access with deny-first policy profiles.
- [Neuron AI](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/neuron-ai.html) (added 2026-10-18): PHP framework for creating and orchestrating AI agents with LLMs, tools, vector stores and memory.
- [Skybridge](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/skybridge.html) (added 2026-10-18): Full-stack TypeScript and React framework for building MCP Apps and ChatGPT Apps.
